description.value: Head Over Wheels is a brick-and-mortar bicycle shop established in Qualicum Beach in 1999, carrying Trek, Specialized, and Electra bikes. The shop is run by two cycling enthusiasts, including a seasoned mechanic who also builds local bike trails, giving it deep roots in the Vancouver Island riding community. Services range from repairs and tune-ups to professional bike fittings, consignment, and special orders from supplier catalogues.

address.value: 130 W Second Ave, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1T3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM phone number exactly. The shop lists repairs, tune-ups, and bike fittings as core services with a seasoned mechanic on staff, supporting the mechanicals criterion; no mention of a floor pump. E-bike service is confirmed indirectly via explicit BC E-Bike Rebate Program participation, e-bike sales (Electra brand), and the stated policy of servicing 'all makes and models of bicycles.' OSM carries addr:unit 'F' but the website address has no unit designation, which is flagged as a minor discrepancy.
concerns: OSM tag addr:unit='F' suggests the shop may be in unit F of a building, but the website lists the address as '130 W Second Ave' with no unit designation; the unit may be outdated or incorrect in OSM.
OSM record has no street address field populated — address was taken entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service bike shop with on-site mechanic, repairs for all bike types including e-bikes, and a long history in the Qualicum Beach cycling community — clear value for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

E-bike service.detail: Shop sells e-bikes (Electra brand listed; BC E-Bike Rebate Program participation confirmed) and services 'all makes and models of bicycles.'
